Note on Remotion (used by Reel Studio, **not** by SAFAA Studio): the Remotion License is free only for individuals, non-profits and companies with up to 3 employees; larger companies need a company license (remotion.dev/license). Nothing from Remotion is included here.

SAFAA Studio's own tools (arabize, ads, publish-kit, studio, dashboard, lesson, motion templates, engine/) are written from scratch.

SKY's own motion library (the plugin owner's work): motion-bank moves 265–283 (`skills/io-video-editor/motion/moves-plus-f.js`) and 284–352 (`moves-plus-g.js`, `moves-plus-h.js`, `moves-plus-i.js`, original SKY code after reference reels — no third-party assets), the `ui-card-reel` and `night-street` motion templates, and the green screen engine (`engine/greenscreen/`). The theme fixes to moves 16 (`highlight`), 55 (`headlineWall`) and 65 (`stickerFreeze`) in `skills/io-video-editor/motion/moves.js` are modifications of the MIT-licensed video-ad-editor engine (© 2026 Majed Alzaabi, `LICENSE.video-ad-editor`).

## Reel Studio visual ports (moves 201–227, caption styles)
Portions of SAFAA Studio's motion bank (moves 201–227 in `skills/io-video-editor/motion/moves-plus-c.js`, the inline-kashida caption option `capKashida:"inline"`, and the `box`/`karaoke`/`outline`/`paper` caption styles in `skills/io-video-editor/scripts/compose.REFERENCE.html`) are adapted from **Reel Studio** — MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Mohamed Abdou — https://github.com/mohamedabdou-ai/reel-studio (license: `LICENSE.reel-studio`). The logic was re-implemented for a Canvas 2D engine; no Reel Studio, React or Remotion code is bundled. Map geometry (moves 214–215): Natural Earth 5.1.1 (public domain), Palestine point-of-view edition, simplified and clipped. Moves 228–232 are an original SAFAA design.
